thread:
oncall-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx error rate detected on prod-gateway (TLS handshake failures). Paged rotation for SRE oncall. Severity: P2. Link: https://alerts.redwood.example/alert/2425008765 :rotating_light:

mira: i'm looking — dashboard shows handshake_failures spiking ~10:52 UTC, 60s rolling error rate ~18% for /v1/generate (edge gateways).

john: any config push or cert rotation around that time? i see a cert rotation job finished ~10:45 from deploy job 2026-03-15T10:45Z.

mira: yep, last cert push was automatic via rotator. seems correlated. grabbing logs from gateway-edge-7.

mira: logs: ```
2026-03-15T10:52:03Z gateway-edge-7 tls_handshake_error: "ssl3_get_client_hello:unknown protocol"
2026-03-15T10:52:04Z gateway-edge-3 tls_handshake_error: "tlsv1 alert unknown ca"
2026-03-15T10:52:05Z gateway-edge-12 accept: error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate unknown
```

priya: hmm that second line looks like client cert chain failing — maybe mTLS ca bundle mismatch after rotation. Which CA did rotator push?

john: rotator pushed CA chain id ca-2026-03-14-v2.pem to all regions. i see in the rotator job logs a warning about missing intermediate in EU region but job marked success: ```rotator: warning: chain incomplete for ca-2026-03-14-v2.pem -> succeeded with warning```

mira: ok initial triage: certificate/chain rotation likely incomplete on some edge nodes causing mutual TLS verification to fail, clients see 5xx gateway errors. Impact: ~15% of requests to /v1/generate across EU region are 5xx. Some customers on dedicated infra report increased error rates.

sam: customer impact — support queues lighting up, a few high-usage customers (acct-redwood-inc, acct-asyncai) reporting request timeouts. marking customerImpact: partial-degradation.

mira: mitigation path options: 1) rollback rotator to previous CA bundle, 2) patch edge nodes to re-upload missing intermediate, 3) fallback route to dedicated-pass-through (no mTLS) for affected customers.

john: rolling rollback now for rotator. executing: ```
# rollback CA bundle
deploy-rotator rollback --bundle ca-2026-02-28-v1.pem --apply-region eu-west-1
```

eng-deploy-bot: deploy-rotator: rollback job started (job id: 13579). estimated time ~2m.

mira: while rollback is in flight, enable temporary graceful fallback for customer routes to avoid complete failures. I'll add policy to route to non-mtls-backend for customers flagged as high-impact.

priya: how do we mark customers? i can push route update for acct-redwood-inc and acct-asyncai. command: ```
redwood route update --org acct-redwood-inc --policy allow-non-mtls --ttl 10m
redwood route update --org acct-asyncai --policy allow-non-mtls --ttl 10m
```

mira: do it. also let's increase rate-limit tokens for retry windows and set 429->retry-after short to avoid client hammer.

sam: notifying affected customers now: "We're investigating increased error rates; temporary routing to avoid failures. We'll update in 15m." :email:

eng-deploy-bot: rollback job completed: success on eu-west-1 and eu-central-1, some nodes reported certificate chain fixed. job id: 13579.

john: reloading gateway proxies to pick up corrected chain: ```
for node in edge-3 edge-7 edge-12; do systemctl restart gateway-proxy && sleep 5; done
```

mira: watching metrics — handshake failures dropping from 18% -> 3% in last 45s. tailing logs to confirm: ```
2026-03-15T10:54:40Z gateway-edge-7 info: TLS handshake success
2026-03-15T10:54:41Z gateway-edge-3 info: TLS handshake success
```

priya: route updates applied to the two customers. monitoring for errors on their sessions.

sam: support reports first wave of customers seeing recovery. marking incident status: mitigated but under monitoring.

mira: follow-ups: 1) postmortem to cover why rotator succeeded despite missing intermediate, 2) add stronger validation in rotator (chain completeness + OCSP check), 3) add canary rollouts for cert chain across regions, 4) quick playbook for temporary non-mTLS routing and customer opt-in.

john: i'll open ticket INFRA-3287 to add chain completeness check and block success on missing intermediate.

mira: documenting timeline for ops: ```
- 10:45 rotator job ran and marked success
- 10:52 spike in TLS handshake failures (~18% 5xx)
- 10:53 incident paged, rotator rollback initiated
- 10:55 rollback completed and proxies reloaded
- 10:56 error rates down to baseline (~1-2%)
```

eng-deploy-bot: Incident status changed to MONITORING. Duration: 11m.

sam: handoff to next oncall in 20m. @john please add any outstanding checks to the oncall checklist.

john: will do — adding: verify ocsp stapling on gateway, confirm tls cert chain on all regions, ensure rotator job re-run in staging with strict checks.

mira: thanks all. raising postmortem and customer-notice draft. cc @support_lead for drafts. :white_check_mark:

support_lead: draft acked. will send targeted customer notification after PM review.

mira: closing thread for now, continue monitoring for 30m then archive.
